info.name: WatchManagement Saga
info.description: Proves saga completion and compensation through the API Gateway. Run the whole collection in order (requests share variables). Scenario letters follow section 6.2 of the assignment guide. Open the Console to see each saga's step chain.

item.name: 00 - Setup
item.description: Login and remember the starting brand counts.

exec: pm.test("5 brands, each with watchCount", () => { pm.expect(brands.length).to.eql(5); brands.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.watchCount).to.be.a("number")); });
pm.test("newest first", () => { const ids = list.map(w => w.watchId); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([...ids].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });
pm.test("message: Account is inactive", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Account is inactive"));
pm.test("message: Token is not a refresh token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Token is not a refresh token"));

item.name: 02 - Validation before the saga
item.description: Invalid input is rejected with 400 and creates no SagaStates row.

exec: pm.test("message: Release date must be today", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Release date must be today"));
pm.test("message: Category not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Category not found"));

item.name: 03 - A: CREATE success
item.description: 1 request updates 2 databases; the new watch is at the top of the list.

exec: pm.test("has watchId and categoryName", () => { pm.expect(d.watchId).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(d.categoryName).to.eql("Dive Watches"); });
const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS"]));

item.name: New watch is first in the list
04 - B: CREATE with brand 999
item.description: Step 1 was committed, then undone by DELETE_WATCH.

exec: pm.test("reason mentions cause", () => pm.expect(body.data.reason).to.include("Brand not found with id: 999"));
const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND FAILED", "COMPENSATE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));
pm.test("list does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(Boolean(w)).to.eql(false));
pm.test("brand does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(d.watchIds.includes(id)).to.eql(false));

item.name: 05 - C: CREATE + fail after step 2
item.description: MSBrand already committed; UNASSIGN_BRAND runs BEFORE DELETE_WATCH (LIFO).

exec: const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);

pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE CREATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED", "COMPENSATE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "COMPENSATE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));
pm.test("list does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(Boolean(w)).to.eql(false));
pm.test("brand does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(d.watchIds.includes(id)).to.eql(false));
pm.test("new id follows the compensated id (" + failed + ")", () => pm.expect(d.watchId).to.eql(failed + 1));

item.name: 06 - UPDATE: success, D, E
item.description: RESTORE_WATCH from the snapshot; ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK to the old brand.

exec: pm.test("data updated", () => { pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("Saga Watch Updated"); pm.expect(d.brandId).to.eql(2); });
const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS"]));

item.name: MSBrand: brand 1 no longer has it

exec: pm.test("brand does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(d.watchIds.includes(id)).to.eql(false));
const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND FAILED", "COMPENSATE RESTORE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));
pm.test("name, brand and price are the old values", () => { pm.expect(w.name).to.eql("Saga Watch Updated"); pm.expect(w.brandId).to.eql(2); pm.expect(w.price).to.eql(2000); });

item.name: E: update to brand 3 + fail after step 2 -> 500

exec: const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);

pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE UPDATE_WATCH SUCCESS", "EXECUTE ASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED", "COMPENSATE ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK SUCCESS", "COMPENSATE RESTORE_WATCH SUCCESS"]));

item.name: E: brand 2 still has the watch
E: brand 3 does not have it

exec: pm.test("brand does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(d.watchIds.includes(id)).to.eql(false));
pm.test("name, brand and price are the old values", () => { pm.expect(w.name).to.eql("Saga Watch Updated"); pm.expect(w.brandId).to.eql(2); pm.expect(w.price).to.eql(2000); });

item.name: 07 - DELETE: F, G (pivot)
item.description: Compensation on the MSBrand side; after the pivot there is no way back.

exec: const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION TRIGGERED", "COMPENSATE ASSIGN_BRAND_BACK SUCCESS"]));

item.name: F: brand 2 still has the watch

exec: const chain = saga.steps.map(s => s.phase + " " + s.stepName + " " + s.result);
pm.test("steps in exact order", () => pm.expect(chain).to.eql(["EXECUTE UNASSIGN_BRAND SUCCESS", "EXECUTE DELETE_WATCH SUCCESS", "FAULT FAULT_INJECTION SKIPPED"]));
pm.test("list does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(Boolean(w)).to.eql(false));

item.name: G: brand 2 is back to baseline

exec: pm.test("brand does not contain watch " + id, () => pm.expect(d.watchIds.includes(id)).to.eql(false));

item.name: Clean up: delete the id-jump watch -> 200
Every brand count is back to baseline
